description: This Java interface defines message headers for a messaging system within the Eclipse Ditto project, including methods for building, accessing, and manipulating message header data such as direction, subject, thing ID, feature ID, content type, timeout, timestamp, and status code.

classes.name: MessageHeaders
classes.description: Interface representing immutable message headers with methods to create, access, and modify header data.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new builder for MessageHeaders with specified message direction, thing ID, and subject.

methods.name: newBuilderForClaiming
methods.description: Creates a new builder for claim messages with specified thing ID.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a MessageHeaders instance from a map of header key-value pairs or a JSON object.

methods.name: toBuilder
methods.description: Returns a builder pre-populated with current header data for modification.

methods.name: getDirection
methods.description: Returns the direction of the message (FROM or TO).

methods.name: getSubject
methods.description: Returns the subject of the message.

methods.name: getThingEntityId
methods.description: Returns the typed ID of the Thing associated with the message.

methods.name: getFeatureId
methods.description: Returns the optional feature ID associated with the message.

methods.name: getContentType
methods.description: Returns the optional content type of the message payload.

methods.name: getTimeout
methods.description: Returns the optional timeout duration for the message.

methods.name: getTimestamp
methods.description: Returns the optional timestamp of the message.

methods.name: getStatusCode
methods.description: Returns the optional HTTP status code of the message.
